quests.name: The Iron Warden
quests.description: The Warden blocks the road east. End it, and bring Maren proof.

quests.name: Supply Run
quests.description: Raiders hit Joss's wagon on the Ashen Road. Get his parts back.

quests.name: Lost Locket
quests.description: Pip dropped a silver locket somewhere in the scrapyard.

stages.text: Ask Brannick to open the east gate.
Cross the Ashen Road to the old foundry.
Bring the Warden Core to Elder Maren.
Find the raiders' cache on the Ashen Road.
Bring the Machine Parts back to Joss.
Search the scrapyard north of the square.
Give the locket back to Pip.
